justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly interpreted the user's date and time preferences throughout the conversation, even when the user changed their mind multiple times.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent consistently reported unavailability and asked the user to pick a new time without offering a range of options, leading to a frustrating experience.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeatedly found slots that were immediately unavailable, leading to many unproductive turns and a drawn-out conversation.
justifications.customer_experience: The customer experience was extremely frustrating due to the agent repeatedly finding and then failing to book available slots, leading to a complete waste of the user's time.
justifications.recovery_quality: The agent failed to recover gracefully from repeated booking failures, offering the same type of unhelpful suggestions and ultimately being unable to secure an appointment.

overall_notes: The core issue in this conversation was the agent's inability to book any of the slots it identified as available, which led to a highly frustrating and ultimately unsuccessful interaction for the user.
